posts.name: 2022 Likud voters

Three days to 27 October. Where the published numbers stand, with sources:

- Likud led in 14 of 41 polls (fieldwork 27 Sep to 22 Oct). All 14 were published by Channel 14 or i24NEWS. Channel 13 (19 seats) and Kan 11 (20 seats), both 23 Oct, put Likud second.
- Walla, 20 Oct: 68% of Likud voters are completely sure of their vote, vs 40% for Yashar and 23% for Together.
- Haaretz, 23 Oct: 56% of religious Zionists who voted Likud in 2022 don't plan to vote Likud this time. Most lean toward Ben-Gvir or Smotrich. That is the leak we take most seriously.

Our base is smaller but committed. The right is fragmented, and that is the real risk. Our base is not a monolith, and loyalty is not blind. In 2022 the mainstream final polls had Likud at 30 or 31 seats, and we got 32.

Polls are snapshots. Check your polling station, bring one undecided friend, and vote on 27 October.
